newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EIB issues 20 bln esc, 20-yr 'Navigator' bond.
newsitem.headline: EIB issues 20 bln esc, 20-yr 'Navigator' bond.

text.p: The European Investment Bank is launching a 20-billion escudo, 20-year 'Navigator' bond at a fixed rate of eight percent, lead manager and bookrunner Banco Cisf said.
The issue is the first ever 20-year Navigator bond, Cisf said.
"The maturity of this issue goes significantly beyond the actual yield-curve of the escudo," the bank said in a statement.
The longest fixed-rate escudo bond is for 10 years.
CISF said the issue was aimed at pension funds, insurance companies and fund managers with long-term responsibilities.
The issue was also aimed at those who believed spreads between Portuguese bonds and German bunds would continue to tighten, it added.
Issuer: European Investment Bank Type: Fixed
Amount: 20 billion esc Rating: AAA (Standard & Poor's),
Govt law: Portuguese Lead manager: Banco Cisf
